name: zsnd_wave_data_parse_loaded_wave_file
description: zSndWaveData::ParseLoadedWaveFile validates RIFF/WAVE buffers and records fmt, data, and cue chunks.
tier_s_evidence: VC5SP3 /Ob0 byte verification for 0x4a5460 passed with zero unmasked byte mismatches; relocation bytes masked: 0.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation at 0x4a5460 validates null fileData returns 0; non-null input clears fmt/pcmData/pcmByteCount, checks RIFF/WAVE magic, scans 16-bit-even-aligned chunks, records the first fmt chunk with size at least 14, records data chunk body and byte count, records cue count and cue point array, stops scanning on a short fmt chunk, and returns 1 after non-null parsing.
The native load/parse/reset smoke verifies the normal PCM RIFF path through zSndWaveData construction, including populated fmt, pcmData, pcmByteCount, fileData, and parsedOk fields.

The direct chunk-parser smoke verifies null fileData, invalid RIFF magic clearing parsed pointers, odd-sized chunk alignment, cue chunk capture, fmt/data chunk capture, and short-fmt early stop before a later data chunk.
